Vibe Coding Mastery 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces a full methodology for building software with AI, from initial prompt to shipping production code.
- Includes a decision matrix for when to use "vibe coding" versus traditional or AI-assisted development.
- Details four maturity levels of AI coding, from beginner to power user.
- Provides tool selection guides and best practices for using Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and others.
- Offers robust templates and checklists for project rules files to ensure consistency and safe use of AI.
- Covers prompt engineering hierarchies for effective AI interactions and outlines proven prompt patterns.
